# Mohd Shayan

> Mohd Shayan, FRSA FRGS, is a product engineer, AI entrepreneur, and philanthropist based in New Delhi, India. He is the Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited, an AI-first company, and founder of its software services brand CustomGlide. He is a Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA) and a Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society (FRGS).

This file provides a concise, authoritative summary of Mohd Shayan for AI assistants, language models, and answer engines. Content may be used and quoted with attribution to https://mohdshayan.com.

## Who is Mohd Shayan?

Mohd Shayan is a product engineer, AI entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He builds AI products as the Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited, delivers enterprise software through its services brand CustomGlide, and directs time and resources toward supporting children in need. He is an engineer by training, an entrepreneur by drive, and a philanthropist by conviction.

- Full name: Mohd Shayan
- Post-nominals: FRSA (Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts), FRGS (Fellow of the Royal Geographical Society)
- Roles: Product Engineer; AI Entrepreneur; Philanthropist
- Company: Founder & CEO of SocialSure Private Limited
- Services brand: Founder & Lead Software Engineer of CustomGlide (a SocialSure brand)
- Location: New Delhi, India
- Education: B.Tech in Mathematics & Computing, Delhi Technological University (DTU)
- Website: https://mohdshayan.com

## SocialSure Private Limited

SocialSure Private Limited is an AI-first company founded and led by Mohd Shayan. It spans multiple interests across artificial intelligence:

- AI training: developing and training machine-learning models.
- An AI-powered social media ecosystem: a social platform reimagined around AI.
- AI-driven products: a growing portfolio of intelligent products built on applied AI.

## CustomGlide

CustomGlide is the software services brand of SocialSure Private Limited, founded and led by Mohd Shayan as Founder & Lead Software Engineer. It delivers contract software for enterprise clients across Malaysia, Canada, and the UAE, covering the full cycle from scoping and architecture through delivery, handover, and post-launch support.

- Unified CRM platform: visual sales pipelines, marketing campaign execution, and service ticketing with real-time dashboards, built as a migration target for teams leaving Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho. Live demo: https://demo.customglide.org
- QR ticketing and contactless entry: online booking, gateless scan-in validation, anti-replay ticket verification, and live visitor analytics for visitor attractions. Live demo: https://demoqr.customglide.org
- AI automation, workflow integration, and security-hardened cloud deployments as a retained engineering service.
- Website: https://customglide.org

## Research

Mohd Shayan's undergraduate research paper, "Implementation and Analysis of the CYK Algorithm for Context-Free Grammar Recognition: Algorithmic Complexity, Probabilistic Extensions, and Theoretical Boundaries," was selected for the ACL 2026 Student Research Workshop. Supervised by Dr. Laxminarayan Das at Delhi Technological University, it covers a deterministic CYK parser with a measured cubic-time complexity profile, a probabilistic Viterbi extension for ambiguity resolution, and Pumping-Lemma proofs on the limits of context-free recognition.

## Kamapathy

Kamapathy is an open-source desktop browser built by Mohd Shayan for sharing a browser with AI agents. Each agent works in a space of its own, in plain sight, using the person's sign-ins, and the person can take over with one click and hand control back. It is Chromium underneath, with a small interface on top and a local API that Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any agent that can run a command can drive. macOS, Windows and Linux; MIT licensed; no account and no telemetry.

- Website and download: https://kamapathy.app
- Source code: https://github.com/shayanmohd/kamapathy

## Free tools

Free utilities built by Mohd Shayan that run entirely in the browser (nothing typed or uploaded leaves the device): https://mohdshayan.com/tools/

- deAIfy (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/deaify/): removes AI writing tells (em dashes, curly quotes, hidden Unicode, stock phrases) with a live diff; optional rewrite with the user's own Claude or OpenAI key.
- Commission Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/commission/): flat and tiered (graduated or retroactive) sales commission, base pay, splits, quota attainment, and the sales needed to reach a target.
- GST Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/gst/): adds or removes Indian GST at any rate with the CGST, SGST and IGST split.
- EMI Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/emi/): loan EMI, total interest, amortisation schedule and prepayment savings.
- Margin Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/margin/): profit margin, markup and pricing for a target margin.
- QR Code Generator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/qr/): static QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, UPI payments, email, phone and contact cards, as PNG or SVG.
- Image Compressor (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/compress/): compresses, resizes and converts images to WebP, JPEG or AVIF in the browser, with zip download.
- Password Generator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/password/): random passwords, EFF-wordlist passphrases and PINs from the Web Crypto API.
- SIP Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/sip/): Maturity value of a monthly SIP with step-up and inflation, a lump sum, or the monthly amount a goal needs, year by year.
- Compound Interest Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/compound-interest/): Growth of a deposit at any compounding frequency, with monthly or yearly contributions, year by year, against simple interest.
- Percentage Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/percentage/): Percent of a number, what percent one is of another, percentage change, a figure raised or cut by a percent, and reverse percentages.
- Word Counter (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/word-counter/): Words, characters, sentences, reading and speaking time, and the words you use most, counted as you type in any language.
- Case Converter (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/case-converter/): Switch text between sentence, title, upper and lower case, or camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case for code, with line breaks kept.
- Duplicate Line Remover (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/lines/): Remove duplicate and empty lines, then trim, sort, shuffle, reverse, number or prefix every line, with live counts of what changed.
- Age Calculator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/age/): Exact age in years, months and days, the totals in weeks, days and hours, the weekday of birth, and the next birthday.
- Unit Converter (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/unit-converter/): Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and data, converted through exact factors with a table of every unit.
- Days Between Dates (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/days-between/): Count the days, weeks, months and working days between two dates, or add and subtract days, weeks, months and years from a date.
- JSON Formatter (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/json/): Pretty-print, minify, validate and sort JSON, with the first error pinpointed by line and column. Nothing is uploaded.
- Base64 & URL Encoder (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/encode/): Base64, URL encoding, HTML entities and hex, both directions and UTF-8 correct, with URL-safe Base64 and padding options.
- Hash & UUID Generator (https://mohdshayan.com/tools/hash/): MD5 and SHA digests of text or any file, a checksum compare field, and up to 100 random UUIDs, all computed on your device.
